_comment: Firewall-locked test of the original server on the owner's own PC (owner decision 2026-10-21, SERVER-TESTING-PLAN.md section 10). Read by deploy/host-test/scripts/*.ps1. No secrets here: they are generated into <root>\secrets, which only the owner and administrators can read.

server.exeNote: Unity 4.5.5f1 win32_nondevelopment player_win.exe from Unity's signed installer, identical except the icon images (docs/server-file-scans.md).
server.argsSource: Run Server.bat shipped in the zip
server.removeNote: VAC2.dll carries a Valve signature that no longer matches (modified after signing; its code is encrypted, so the change cannot be read). LumaEmu's steamclient.dll loads it for VAC; the test copy runs without it.
server.lumaEmuNote: Shipped values Offline=0, Master=1 (Valve master server heartbeats), UnlockDLC=1 (fetches DLC app IDs from the internet). The test copy turns all three off; the firewall blocks them anyway.

procmon.note: Download Process Monitor from learn.microsoft.com/sysinternals (Microsoft-signed) and pass -ProcmonExe if it lives elsewhere.
